integrity: The proof derives the center, derived subgroup, Frattini subgroup, square map, and complete element-order distribution directly from the matrix multiplication law. The finite replay is an independent check for q=2,4,8,16 and is not used to justify the universal quantifier.
scientific_limitations: The formula is proved for UT_3 over finite fields of characteristic two, not for all nonabelian special 2-groups.
The originality claim excludes q=2, which is an extraspecial boundary case already covered in prior work.
Higher unitriangular groups have additional element-order strata and are not covered.
An equivalent order-distribution formula may exist in older unitriangular-group literature under different terminology.
title: Sum of element orders in \(UT_3(\mathbf F_{2^m})\)
